title: Trapping Exits (process_flag(trap_exit, true)), The Exit Signal Truth Table & Untrappable kill
solutionExplanation: Implements supervisor primitives using trap_exit to convert exit signals into mailbox messages and respawn crashed workers, proving the complete exit signal truth table.

otpDocCards.description: Enables exit signal trapping, converting incoming exits into mailbox messages.
Sends exit signal with Reason to target Pid. If Reason is kill, target terminates unconditionally.

mentalModelCheck.question: Why does sending `exit(WorkerPid, kill)` terminate a worker even if that worker has executed `process_flag(trap_exit, true)`?
mentalModelCheck.codeSnippet:
process_flag(trap_exit, true),
%% Inside another process:
exit(WorkerPid, kill).

options.label: The atom `kill` is Erlang’s untrappable nuclear signal; the runtime bypasses mailbox trapping and terminates the process unconditionally.
options.explanation: Correct! `kill` is unconditionally untrappable. The BEAM runtime terminates the process directly, rewriting the reason to `killed` for linked peers so supervisors survive.

options.label: Trapping exits only works for throws, not exits.
options.explanation: Trapping exits is specifically for exit signals.

options.label: The target process traps the signal as {EXIT, Pid, kill}.
